mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pmis_billable_utilization_snapshot (period, employee_id, employee_name, level_code, department, total_hours, billable_hours, overtime_hours, leave_hours, training_hours, bench_hours, utilization_pct, grade, range_from, range_to, snapshot_at, source, tenant_id, deleted) VALUES (#{row.period}, #{row.employeeId}, #{row.employeeName}, #{row.levelCode}, #{row.department}, #{row.totalHours}, #{row.billableHours}, #{row.overtimeHours}, #{row.leaveHours}, #{row.trainingHours}, #{row.benchHours}, #{row.utilizationPct}, #{row.grade}, #{row.rangeFrom}, #{row.rangeTo}, #{row.snapshotAt}, #{row.source}, #{row.tenantId}, COALESCE(#{row.deleted}, 0)) ON CONFLICT (period, employee_id) DO UPDATE SET employee_name = EXCLUDED.employee_name, level_code = EXCLUDED.level_code, department = EXCLUDED.department, total_hours = EXCLUDED.total_hours, billable_hours = EXCLUDED.billable_hours, overtime_hours = EXCLUDED.overtime_hours, leave_hours = EXCLUDED.leave_hours, training_hours = EXCLUDED.training_hours, bench_hours = EXCLUDED.bench_hours, utilization_pct = EXCLUDED.utilization_pct, grade = EXCLUDED.grade, range_from = EXCLUDED.range_from, range_to = EXCLUDED.range_to, snapshot_at = EXCLUDED.snapshot_at, source = EXCLUDED.source
mapper.delete: UPDATE pmis_billable_utilization_snapshot SET deleted = 1, snapshot_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE period = #{period} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id, period, employee_id, employee_name, level_code, department, total_hours, billable_hours, overtime_hours, leave_hours, training_hours, bench_hours, utilization_pct, grade, range_from, range_to, snapshot_at, source, tenant_id, deleted FROM pmis_billable_utilization_snapshot WHERE period = #{period} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY utilization_pct DESC

SELECT id, period, employee_id, employee_name, level_code, department, total_hours, billable_hours, overtime_hours, leave_hours, training_hours, bench_hours, utilization_pct, grade, range_from, range_to, snapshot_at, source, tenant_id, deleted FROM pmis_billable_utilization_snapshot WHERE deleted = 0 AND ((range_from <= #{to} AND range_to >= #{from})) ORDER BY period DESC, utilization_pct DESC

SELECT COALESCE(AVG(utilization_pct), 0) AS avg_pct, COALESCE(SUM(total_hours), 0) AS sum_total, COALESCE(SUM(billable_hours), 0) AS sum_billable, COALESCE(SUM(bench_hours), 0) AS sum_bench, COUNT(DISTINCT employee_id) AS headcount, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE grade = 'EXCELLENT') AS excellent_count, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE grade = 'GOOD') AS good_count, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE grade = 'NORMAL') AS normal_count, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE grade = 'WARN') AS warn_count, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE grade = 'CRITICAL') AS critical_count FROM pmis_billable_utilization_snapshot WHERE period = #{period} AND deleted = 0

SELECT COALESCE(AVG(utilization_pct), 0) AS avg_pct, COALESCE(SUM(total_hours), 0) AS sum_total, COALESCE(SUM(billable_hours), 0) AS sum_billable, COALESCE(SUM(bench_hours), 0) AS sum_bench, COUNT(DISTINCT employee_id) AS headcount, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE grade = 'EXCELLENT') AS excellent_count, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE grade = 'GOOD') AS good_count, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE grade = 'NORMAL') AS normal_count, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE grade = 'WARN') AS warn_count, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE grade = 'CRITICAL') AS critical_count FROM pmis_billable_utilization_snapshot WHERE deleted = 0 AND range_from <= #{to} AND range_to >= #{from}

SELECT COALESCE(department, '未分配') AS department, COALESCE(AVG(utilization_pct), 0) AS avg_pct, COALESCE(SUM(billable_hours), 0) AS sum_billable, COALESCE(SUM(bench_hours), 0) AS sum_bench, COUNT(DISTINCT employee_id) AS headcount FROM pmis_billable_utilization_snapshot WHERE period = #{period} AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY department ORDER BY avg_pct DESC
SELECT grade, COUNT(1) AS cnt, COALESCE(AVG(utilization_pct), 0) AS avg_pct FROM pmis_billable_utilization_snapshot WHERE period = #{period} AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY grade ORDER BY grade

SELECT id, period, employee_id, employee_name, level_code, department, total_hours, billable_hours, overtime_hours, leave_hours, training_hours, bench_hours, utilization_pct, grade, range_from, range_to, snapshot_at, source, tenant_id, deleted FROM pmis_billable_utilization_snapshot WHERE period = #{period} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY utilization_pct DESC LIMIT #{top}

SELECT id, period, employee_id, employee_name, level_code, department, total_hours, billable_hours, overtime_hours, leave_hours, training_hours, bench_hours, utilization_pct, grade, range_from, range_to, snapshot_at, source, tenant_id, deleted FROM pmis_billable_utilization_snapshot WHERE period = #{period} AND deleted = 0 AND grade IN ('WARN', 'CRITICAL') ORDER BY utilization_pct ASC
